{{Quote|PK units are my first recommendation for the espionage programming. After all, who notices a PK?|[[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Vyn Narcassan]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
The '''PK-series worker droid''', also known as the '''PK-4 worker droid''', was a small, [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] for general labor use.

==Characteristics==
[[File:PK4WorkerDroidSide-FF137.png|thumb|left|150px|A PK-series [[Droid/Legends|droid]].]]
The PK-series worker droid was durable and versatile, able to perform basic tasks such as: simple repairs, organize supplies, clean up offices, and inventory cargo. They were equipped with extremely efficient batteries that allowed them to go long times between charging sessions.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" /> They were very common and retailed for about 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. They were grey and not armed.

==History==
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] arranged to purchase the entire production run of PK droids from [[Telti/Legends|Telti]]. Vyn Narcassan met with the board of directors of Cybot Galactica and persuaded them to allow him to introduce espionage programming into the droids. Approximately one out of every 400 included a passive communication trap to intercept conversations and transmissions. The data was collected by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agents working undercover as Cybot technicians.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" />

[[File:Round-up-Gungans.png|thumb|right|300px|PK droids do cleanup work (center) after the Battle of the Grassy Plains.]]
Several could be seen working aboard [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] as they maintained the trade federation's flocks of battle droids, droidekas, and vulture droid starfighters. They also did cleanup work in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]].

A fancier version of the PK was the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal Naboo]] [[PKN-49 worker droid]]. Additionally, Cybot Galactica used the chassis and many other parts from the PK to build other droids, including the [[SP-4 analysis droid/Legends|SP-4]] and [[JN-66 analysis droid/Legends|JN-66]] [[Analysis droid/Legends|analysis droids]] used in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the [[IM-6 Battlefield Medical Droid/Legends|IM-6 battlefield medical droid]] used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].

A broken-down PK droid was responsible for monitoring the spaceport at [[Tun Aduban]] on [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].
